items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Ralph Sutton and hiw wife Sonny who owned their own club in Aspen -- we worked there together

ctx.x: But you should also give credit to people who helped you through these things.

Oh yes, well, this is my wife. And to make a comeback -- Ralph Sutton helped me after I got over this terrible seige, he, Ralph Sutton and hiw wife Sonny who owned their own club in Aspen -- we worked there together -- insisted that I come up and I said I don't think I'm ready yet, I don't think I can play without drinking. Well, I found out I could. But it took me years.

So I found out that you don't need any stimulant. I can get very high on black coffee. I can get extremely high, because I'm a fairly nervous person. And it took me a lot of years to learn something. I used to think that I got warmed up by drinking, I guess kids still do today. But my warming up period -- I'd get there an hour to two hours ahead of time on any job that I do, even if my drums are all set up, like with a steady job or a concert hall -- and I spent two hours there warming my hands up.
